'''Horalax''' was a [[Retro-Paxist poets|Retro-Paxist]] [[Poet/Legends|poet]]. He was known for his use of [[Atrisian script]] to help highlight the ironic contrast between the empires of the past and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
